characters.description: The Witchblade is the offspring of the primal forces of the universe, the Darkness and the Angelus. It is male and generally chooses a female host. It is semi-organic and reacts supernaturally to threats. It is able to grant its host a variety of weapons and can heal the wearer. Adaptive Armor: It can become body armor and a weapon at the same time. The amount of armor that comes out of the Witchblade to protect the host will always depend on the level of threat. For example, if the host is fighting a mere mortal, there will be less armor wrapped around the host. But if the host is fighting demonic enemies, it will form more armor to protect its host. Balance Between Light and Darkness: It acts as a balance between the Light (The Angelus) and the Dark (The Darkness), it hosts also have to be balanced between the Light and the Dark. The Witchblade tells Katarina that it rejected her because she wasn't balanced between the Light and the Dark. Blood Knight: It craves battle. Born of Heaven and Hell: The child of The Angelus and The Darkness. Was created to act as a balance between his parents.

characters.name: Sara Pezzini
characters.description: One ofThe current wieldersof the Witchblade in the comics, Sara was a police officer for the NYPD, and was a mom on top of that. She was aPrivate Detectivein Chicago, now a sheriff. Action Girl: Was already one before she gained the Witchblade, being an NYPD officer. Action Mom: To her daughter withJackie, Hope. Ax-Crazy: When under the control of the Darkness half of the Witchblade. Blade Below the Shoulder: Can use the Witchblade to form one sword ortwo swords.

characters.name: Alex Underwood
characters.description: The current wielder of the Witchblade in the 2017 comic. Former war correspondent now works for Witness Aid Services for the New York Assistant District Attorney's Office (after seeing her childhood friend/crush die in Afghanistan). Gains the Witchblade after she's shot by aDirty Copshe was investigating. Combat Tentacles: Par for the course with the Witchblade. Interestingly enough, this time, they look more like energy than the solid metal constructs from Sara's time. Empowered Badass Normal: Even before she gained the Witchblade, she was already trained in Krav Maga. I Just Want to Be Normal: Starts out not wanting to be the Witchblade's wielder, and is pretty reluctant to accept its powers. Intrepid Reporter: Used to be one. Even now working for witness aid, she still can't shake off her old habits.

characters.name: Danielle Baptiste
characters.description: Danielle Baptiste is the daughter of Police Captain Peyroux and Gus Baptiste. She is a classically trained ballerina whose life is turned upside down upon meeting Sara Pezzini, wielder of the Witchblade. She also wielded the power of the Angelus. Ballet: In the old universe she was a ballet dancer, and her teacher even asks her to teach some ballet classes. Blade Below the Shoulder: Can use the Witchblade to form one sword ortwo swords. Brought Down to Badass: Without the Witchblade or the Angelus. Empathic Weapon: The Witchblade

characters.name: Michael Yee
characters.description: Michael Yee was Sara Pezzini's partner before she got the Witchblade. Back from the Dead: Brought back from the dead by Sara and the Witchblade but heCame Back Wrong. Came Back Wrong: His soul came back but his body was still dead. Death Seeker: After being brought back wrong. Fair Cop: He was a police officer for the NYPD.

characters.name: Joe Siry
characters.description: Sara's former captain when she served at the 18th Precinct. He was the partner of Sara and Julie's dead father, Detective Vincent Pezzini, whom he killed to protect Sara from Irons. Da Chief: Sara's former superior officer when she worked at the 18th Precinct. Parental Substitute: He is Sara's father figure.

characters.name: JakeMcCarthy
characters.description: JakeMcCarthyis a former partner to Sara Pezzini. Demonic Possession:He was possessed by a demon's spirit and is taken as the demon's vessel. Driven to Suicide:After he is taken as the demon's vessel. Sara battles him and the evil spirit and weakens them. Jake temporarily regains his senses and kills himself to prevent being taken as a host again. Hopeless Suitor: Was in love with Sara. Secret Secret-Keeper: He knows about the Witchblade but Sara doesn't know he knows—or so he believes.

characters.name: Kenneth Irons
characters.description: The incredibly wealthy CEO of Irons Industries, andvery long lived. His ultimate obsession is trying to find and own the Witchblade, and he doesn't care who or what stands in his way. Badass Normal: As a member ofThe Knights Templar. Corrupt Corporate Executive: He made a lot of his money through drug trafficking, prostitution, slavery, and the arms industry. Dating Catwoman: Subverted—he did date Sara for a brief time, but that was well before they became enemies. Disney Villain Death: He falls off a building; however, this is subverted as he survives the fall.

characters.name: Gerald Irons
characters.description: The son of Kenneth Irons, andvery long lived. His ultimate obsession is trying to find and own the Witchblade, and he doesn't care who or what stands in his way. Badass Normal: As a member ofThe Knights Templar. Dating Catwoman: Subverted—he did date Dani for a brief time, but that was before they became enemies. Disney Villain Death: He falls off a church; however this is subverted he survives the fall badly injured and is arrested by Sara. Empathic Weapon: He steals Dani's half of the Witchblade.

characters.name: Ian Nottingham
characters.description: Irons's right-hand man. An Ice Person: While the bearer of The Glacier Stone he has a body made of ice. Blood Magic: The power of The Blood Sword. The Bus Came Back: He came back after escaping jail with the help of Aphrodite IV. Cool Sword: The Blood Sword.

characters.name: Tora No Shi
characters.description: Tora No Shi is an assassin for hire and former bodyguard of Kenneth Irons. Back from the Dead: Sonataine brought him back to life. Character Death: Twice. Empowered Badass Normal: He is magically enhanced by Sonataine. Red Baron: Tiger of Death.

characters.name: Julie Pezzini
characters.description: Julie Pezzini is the younger sister of Sara Pezzini, wielder of the Witchblade. She was a model and seems to love everything about living in the fast lane, not taking the time to stop and smell the roses. She originally had a really bad habit of breaking into Sara's apartment and freeloading whenever she came into town. Her lifestyle sometimes brought her into conflict with the wrong people. Annoying Younger Sibling: She had a habit of breaking into Sara's apartment and freeloading whenever she came into town. Back from the Dead:In the new universe she never died. The Bus Came Back: She came back after serving her jail sentence and getting cleared up. Foolish Sibling, Responsible Sibling: Sara is the responsible sibling to Julie's foolish sibling. Sara is a cop while Julie has gotten into serious trouble, and has even gone to jail for dealings drugs.

characters.name: Patience/The Magdalena
characters.description: Patience is the latest in the line of women known as the Magdalena, wielders ofThe Spear of Destinywho are descended from Jesus Christ and Mary Magdalene, and once-holy protectors of the Catholic Church. An Ice Person: While the bearer of The Glacier Stone she has a body made of ice. Hoist by His Own Petard: Has been on the receving end ofThe Spear of Destinywhen Sister Anneli attacks her with it. Legacy Character:The Spear of Destinyand the holy power of the Magdalena is passed from mother to daughter. Power Dyes Your Hair: The Glacier Stone turns her hair icy green.

characters.name: The Curator
characters.description: An old man who maintains an antique and curio shop in Manhattan. Cruel and Unusual Death:Jackie tears him to pieces and then displays the parts in the Curator/the Survivor's shop window. Gory Discretion Shot:His death. In the Hood:As the Survivor. Killed Off for Real:By Jackie in the new universe.

characters.name: Sabine
characters.description: Sabine was a lieutenant of the Angelus Warriors. Hoping to be the next Angelus, she became the wielder of Wheel of Shadows instead. Big Bad: Of the Angelus Mini-series. Dark Is Evil; While having the Wheel of Shadows. The Dragon: The former second-in-command of the Angelus Warriors.Dragon Ascendant: Leads Angelus Warriors when the Angelus is hostless.Dragon with an Agenda: Wants the Angelus force for herself. Dragon Ascendant: Leads Angelus Warriors when the Angelus is hostless.

characters.name: Aphrodite IV
characters.description: The fourth in a series of human-like androids, Aphrodite IV is an assassin who (almost) never misses a target. Artificial Human: She is an android. Badass Transplant: The Coin of Solomon was placed within Aphrodite IV's chest. Enemy Mine: Worked with Sara to capture a scientist. Aphrodite IV then betrays Sara and kills the scientist. Legacy Character: She is the fourth in a series of Aphrodite androids and the latest bearer of one of the thirteen Artifacts called The Coin of Solomon.

characters.name: Finch
characters.description: Finch is a dancer at the school Dani Baptiste taught at in New York. Finch later becomes Dani's roommate and has expressed romantic feelings for her. Ballet: She's a ballet dancer. Blade Below the Shoulder: Can use the Witchblade to form one sword ortwo swords. Horned Humanoid: As the Angelus host she has horns on her head. Legacy Character: She is the new Angelus.

characters.name: Tau'ma
characters.description: An old mysterious figure, he is the Curator's brother and knows a lot about the artifacts. Unlike his brother who wants to keep the balance intact, Tau'ma is on the side of Darkness and had manipulated Sara Pezzini in the War of the Witchblades. Big Bad: Of the "War of the Witchblades". Hidden Agenda Villain: His goal hasn't yet been revealed. Know When to Fold 'Em: When Sara regains control of herself, Tau'ma, seeing all the forces are against him, escapes. Manipulative Bastard: Manipulates Sara into fighting Dani.

characters.name: Katarina Godliffe
characters.description: A former wielder of the Witchblade in medieval times (from 1175 to 1178). Worked with Medieval Spawn to fight against Lord Cardinale. She was from York in North Yorkshire inNorth East England, now a sheriff in the Faerie realm andone of the current wielders of the Witchblade in the comics. The Alcoholic: Like her father James Godliffe. Badass Cape: In medieval times she wore a brown cape with a hood. Badass Normal: Without the Witchblade. Bar Brawl: Gets into these quite at bit. After one of them she had to clean out a dung heap to pay a debt to Stalker (it was either that or sleep with Stalker) andshe found the Witchblade in the dung heap. During aBar Brawlin 1178 the Witchblade abandoned her.

characters.name: Danny Woo
characters.description: Sara Pezzini's partner, who dies in the first episode. Back from the Dead:Thanks to the time reversal in the season 1 finale. Buried Alive:In season 2. He's rescued by Sara. Dead Person Conversation: With Sara, thanks to the Witchblade. Expy: He's loosely based on Sara'sDead PartnerMichael Yee from one comic arc: both being Asian-American homicide detectives who got killed in the line of duty and come back from the dead.

characters.name: JakeMcCartey
characters.description: A rookie cop, and Sara Pezzini's new partner following Danny's death. Cowboy Cop: He's no match for Sara in this department, but he's still very gung-ho and is depictedroughing up a suspect in an interrogation. Fair Cop: He's got the boyish good looks to go with his rookie status. The Mole:He's actually an undercoverFBI Agentsent to infiltrate theWhite Bulls. To earn their trust, he feeds them information on Sara when they decide she's a threat, but not enough to actually endanger her personally, and ultimately reveals himself to her. Noble Bigot with a Badge: He's very put-off when he has to investigate aSerial Killertargeting the community of a local gay bar, angering Sara.

characters.name: Masane Amaha
characters.description: The current host of the Witchblade. She has a six-year-old daughter named Rihoko. Absurdly Youthful Mother: Masane's only 23 at the start of the series. Rihoko is six years old. That means that Masane would have been seventeen years old when she had Rihoko.Justified later in the series because she's not Rihoko's biological mother. Action Mom: Becomes this in the later half of the anime, primarily out of concern for Riko's safety. Antenna Hair: Masane has two cowlicks on the back of her head that perpetually stick up. Black Eyes of Crazy: Her sclera also turn black while transformed. Partially subverted in that, while Masane's violent and aggressive when using the Witchblade, she's definitely not evil; and as the show goes on, she gets a handle on her murderous impulses.

characters.name: Rihoko "Riko" Amaha
characters.description: Riko is the only child of Masane Amaha. Cheerful Child: Very rarely do you see her not smiling or interacting in a cheerful manner with the other characters. Children Do the Housework: Her mother is an unemployed single mother and a constant slacker who often wakes up late. Six-year-old Rihoko is usually seen performing domestic tasks like cleaning, washing, and making breakfast. The Chosen One:She is the Witchblade's intended host. It is just using Masane as a stopover while waiting for Riko to mature. Girlish Pigtails: To add to her cuteness, she wears her hair in little pigtails.

characters.name: Reiji Takayama
characters.description: Takayama is the head of the Special Section in Douji Group Industries, which manufactures weapons and researches weapons like the Witchblade. He hired Masane Amaha to dispose of X-Cons. He first appears to be a cold and ruthless man who only cares about his job, but this is not actually the case. Brutal Honesty: He says exactly how he feels and doesn't worry about offending or hurting anyone with his words. Curtains Match the Window: Has black eyes and black hair. Defrosting Ice Queen: A male example. Good Scars, Evil Scars: Has a faint diagonal scar across his right eye.

characters.name: Masaya Wado
characters.description: A work colleague of Takayama's who works as the Director of Bio Division at Douji Group Industries. He's known Takayama since college and sees him as a hated rival. Hidden Depths: Apparently, he has an unusually strong physical constitution that gives him the uncanny ability to hold his liquor. Kick the Dog: He uses his servile aide as aSacrificial Lambfor one of his experiments. Pyrrhic Victory: He eventually succeeds at defeating Takayama, and forces the latter to resign. In doing so, however, he utterly destroys the company he wanted to take over in the process, with no way to recover. As Takayama says himself."The boat has sunk. You shot the hole in the bottom yourself." The Rival: Considers himself to be this to Takayama.

characters.name: Hiroki Segawa
characters.description: Takayama's right-hand man who is always professional and prepared. He loves power and frequently switches sides depending on who has the most power. Chronic Back Stabbing Disorder: By his own admission, he frequently switches sides depending on who has the most power. Professional Butt-Kisser: The reason he's risen so far in the ranks.

characters.name: Yuusuke Tozawa
characters.description: A freelance photographer investigating the "Pulverizer Murders", a series of murders of NSWF employees. While investigating the murders, he discovers the existence of the Witchblade and NSWF's connection to the murders. Curtains Match the Window: He has brown eyes to match his brown hair. Going for the Big Scoop: He often gets himself into trouble with the police and security because of this. Intrepid Reporter: He wants to find out the culprit behind the "Pulverizer Murders." Romantic Runner-Up: He developed feelings for Masane, but when she picks Takayama, he's forced to give up. He still remains supportive to her.

characters.name: Tatsuoki Furumizu
characters.description: Head of the NSWF andfather to Neogenes. Big Bad: From the beginning of the series onwards, he and his organization pose the preeminent threat to Masane and her daughter, Riko.However, this is ultimately subverted given that he is later killed 5 episodes before the series finale by his "daughter" Maria, who subsequently seizes control of the NSWF. Big Ol' Eyebrows: Only Reiji's eyebrows are larger than his. Faux Affably Evil: Despite displaying charm and paternal warmth when interacting with the public and his "children," he is actually a very cruel and cold-hearted individualwho has no regard for the well-being of those who serve him. In-Series Nickname: He is called "Father" by his Neogenes and the children of the city.

characters.name: Reina Soho
characters.description: One of the first Neogenes that Masane encounters and a top NSWF scientist. BFS: What her forearm blade is shaped after - along with the slab-like blades of her giant bangs. Defrosting Ice Queen: She starts out emotionless at the beginning, but after shegains custody of Rihoko she starts showing emotions, including maternal feelings for her daughter. Foil: To Masane. Bothare some maternal figures to Riko—Masane as her adoptive mother and Reina as her biological mother. Masane is constantly on the run from child welfare and is an irresponsibleWomanchild, while Reina is professionally and financially prepared to care for Riko. However, Masane and Riko's bond is a natural and warm one, while Riko and Reina's starts off as distant and slow to progress.To Nora, her rival within the Foundation. Both are stoic, more refined Neogenes with similar abilities and temperaments. However, Reina is independent, while Nora merely follows Father's ambitions. Also, Nora is envious of Reina, and grows cocky in their one duel, while Reina thinks nothing of status and ranks - only her research. To Nora, her rival within the Foundation. Both are stoic, more refined Neogenes with similar abilities and temperaments. However, Reina is independent, while Nora merely follows Father's ambitions. Also, Nora is envious of Reina, and grows cocky in their one duel, while Reina thinks nothing of status and ranks - only her research.

characters.name: Shiori Tsuzuki
characters.description: Reina's assistant and the second Neogene that Masane encounters. Attempted Rape: She was just about to do this to Takayama before herSuper-Power Meltdownwent critical. Ax-Crazy: With the possible exception of Maria, she is definitelythemost violent and depraved of the Witchblade bearers. Blood Knight: Aside from basking in the presence of her beloved Reina, nothing gratifies Shiori more than senseless brutality and the thrill of fighting to the death. Deadly Upgrade:Is theonlyother blade wielder to upgrade her form besides Masane thanks to her poor impulse control - and she breaks down (and dies) faster because of it.

characters.name: Nora
characters.description: Tatsuoki Furumizu's assistant. Arachnid Appearance and Attire: It's relatively subtle, but while transformed, Nora's hair forms itself into long appendages like the legs of a spider. Battle Butler: One of the strongest of the Neogenes, and Furumizu's main muscle. Impaled with Extreme Prejudice:How Reina kills her. In-Series Nickname: "Spider", and for good reason. Not only does she look a little like a spider while transformed, a lot of her attacks and tactics evoke spiders as well.

characters.name: Maria
characters.description: A second-generation Neogene introduced about halfway through the series, deemed to be the strongest ever produced. Powerful and skilled, yet extremely unstable. The Ace: She’s deemed to be the strongest and most skilled Neogene ever produced, and she definitely shows it. Alas, Poor Villain:The last two to three episodes have Maria spiralling out of control with nothing but a desire for power while trying to figure out what it is she truly wants. After being fatally wounded by Masane, Maria is left lamenting whether or not Reina truly loved her as she crystallizes and turns to dust in the wind. Ax-Crazy: Holy shit, yes. Part of what makes her so dangerous is her lack of boundaries and self-control, as pointed out by Reina. Bad Boss:Murders her subordinate Asagi because she was basically tired of her delivering so manyArmor Piercing Questionsto her.
